title: Dhaba-Style Egg Masala
description: Hard-boiled eggs pan-fried and simmered in a spicy, robust onion-tomato gravy. Perfect with buttery flatbreads.

blocks.alt: Hard boiled eggs in a rich orange tomato curry

blocks.text: This spicy and aromatic egg masala is inspired by roadside dhabas. The secret is to pan-fry the boiled eggs until they get a crispy, blistered golden skin before cooking them in the gravy.

items.text: Prick the hard-boiled eggs with a fork. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan, add a pinch of turmeric and chili powder, and shallow-fry the eggs until golden and blistered. Set aside.
In the same pan, add the remaining oil and sauté chopped onions until brown.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute. Add tomatoes, turmeric, chili powder, and cook until tomatoes mush down.
Add half a cup of water, bring to a simmer, and stir in the pan-fried eggs.
Simmer for 3 minutes, then finish with garam masala, kasuri methi crushed between your palms, and fresh cilantro.

blocks.text: Pricking the eggs before shallow frying is crucial; it prevents them from bursting in the hot oil!
